inputs: canonical arrangement entities and scope views
positive dated care claims and all competing work in canonical DOM-02 accounts
procedure: Validate membership and direct institutional jurisdiction; aggregate population using WP-007 direct union rules; map each care claim to one beneficiary obligation; evaluate all work through DOM-02; return prior and additional actual, remaining unmet care and posting evidence without publishing state.
independent_oracle: Ten people in two canonical partition views remain ten, with five shared provider hours. Four hours of care, three employment and two training hours compete. Employment then training leaves four care hours unmet; care first leaves two employment and two training hours unmet. A four-hour care hold protects care capacity. Replaying the staged batch creates no additional fulfillment.
interfaces: DOM-02 dated claims, holders, access, reservations and postings
limits: No inferred household sizes, demographics or health outcomes
No empirical service or care-time coefficient
No legal merits, enforcement or universal family/belonging score
No numerical IPC activation, publication or transition
No parent or cumulative gate acceptance
review_route: SV separate author inspection; independent agent review deferred
